newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sanofi says not involved in reported drugs merger.
newsitem.headline: Sanofi says not involved in reported drugs merger.

text.p: French health and beauty products firm Sanofi is not part of a merger announcement planned between two unnamed companies for Wednesday, a spokesman said on Tuesday.
"We are not involved in this operation," he said.

An executive of the Publicis public relations agency said earlier that a French pharmaceuticals company and another firm would announce details on Wednesday of a transaction that would be the biggest of its kind on the Paris stock market. The announcement was planned for 0800 GMT.
She declined to name the companies involved.
Sanofi is majority-owned by Elf Aquitaine.
